stories.title: Saudi-backed forces launch major offensive against Houthis in Yemen

stories.title: Bolsonaro leads Brazil's presidential race after first round
new_facts: New story: Flávio Bolsonaro's first-round lead over Lula sets up a three-week runoff battle in Brazil's election.
Gives exact first-round vote totals: Bolsonaro 56.1m (47.03%) vs Lula 53.8m (45.16%); candidates' ages 45 and 80.
Brazilian stocks jumped on the result; runoff set for October 25.
Trump administration actively backing Bolsonaro as part of a broader push for conservative allies across Latin America, including Colombia and Argentina.
Adds on-record analysis from Felipe Krause, head of Oxford's Brazilian Studies Programme, on polarization and Bolsonaro's appeal.
Adds analysis from researcher Thomas Zicman de Barros noting this is historically unprecedented for a first-round trailing candidate.
stories.line: Flávio Bolsonaro leads Brazil's presidential race after first-round voting, positioning the right-wing candidate to likely defeat incumbent Lula in a runoff.
